_comment: WI-07 integrity FLOORS. tests/integrity/run_integrity.js fails if the live database drops BELOW any number here. These are floors, never targets: the suite NEVER raises them automatically, because a floor that follows the live value can never detect a loss. A human raises them BY HAND at a REFACTOR_PLAN.md phase checkpoint, after confirming the growth is legitimate (e.g. with tests/integrity/snapshot_diff.js --expect-no-removals across the two backups spanning the change). Record who raised it and why in _history below.

_measuredValues.note: Live values when these floors were set — for context only; the suite reads the floors above, never these.

_history.why: Initial floors, measured directly against psat-cosmos-15958/psat-prep-db.
